blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) is warning the public against vaping products containing etomidate, a short-acting intravenous anesthetic that has been detected in locally seized vape products. Etomidate is a legitimate medical anesthetic used in hospitals to induce general anesthesia. PDEA, however, said using the substance outside medical supervision could […]...
